blockers.message: Preserve original parser success when deep copying exceeds recursion depth

findings: Handoff936abdbd, component312c9318 and manifest9ee30c5c pins match. All8 authored manifest members and selected original v4/adapter/namespace/guard source bytes authenticate. No broad inherited campaign or scientific payload was traversed.

The actual original v4.parse is a pure json.loads computation with a fresh duplicate-key pairs accumulator and nonfinite-constant rejection. It has no resource/clock/IO boundary. Its current standard-library exponent overflow/string/value semantics remain original; the component does not add numerical filtering.

Component constructor validates exact original source/code/module function identity, original parser signature/json library, exact installed read-only namespace handle receipt and original adapter methods. Independent construction used original namespace install on RAM modules; no guard module was imported.

Owned cache admission is path+SHA+exact raw object from the same old handle transaction state and source-derived raw tuple. Equal bytes in a different raw object reject. Capacity misses and controls use original parsing. Genuine historical storage values agree through guard and bound seams, with independently mutable returned copies.

Additional original uncached byte/digest validation occurs before new seams are restored and the old namespace/leaf snapshot frontier resumes. Body/final-byte errors clear parsed state and restore original functions; cold next transactions do not reuse values. Global v4.parse is never patched.

Explicit supplied controls, frozen manifests and guard policy/selector/repair refs are excluded; forbidden basenames/runtime paths and provenance checks constrain eligibility. This component pass does not qualify complete future control closure, caller namespace, route, guard list or administrative/scientific integration.

Cache constants remain256entries,4MiB raw and32MiB conservative repeated-object charge, with original old raw memo bounds unchanged. Raw/parsed cap branches bypass cache in RAM. These are retained cache limits, not whole-RSS allocation, copy cost, lock speed or runtime fit guarantees.

A valid1201-byte JSON array with600 nested levels passes original v4.parse and complete eligible component construction but fails at unprotected deepcopy after actual guard reader/raw/bound ownership succeeds. This deterministic added RecursionError is the source blocker; original error/value behavior is not preserved for all valid eligible inputs.

The failing transaction restores all original reader/ref seams and clears state, so the observed failure is failstop. Cleanup does not remove the source regression or justify excluding valid original JSON to pass.
No future whole route, live consumer adoption, existing C3/FLARE/H058/H060 source/job change, quota/authority framework, speed or performance result is authorized or inferred.
limitations: Source and immutable metadata reads plus pure original parser and selected source-derived component/namespace functions ran with RAM operational providers. No original scheduler mutex, live guard state, process/GPU/resource/accounting/journal operation, actual clock, source mutation or Git operation occurred.
The deep JSON and frozen manifest are explicit RAM fixtures; source-derived ownership and constructor checks are genuine. No actual historical metadata file was edited to contain the fixture.
This focused review neither repeats the full author campaign nor establishes complete route/control exclusions, timing, fit or training throughput.
required_followup: Author an immutable successor repairing deepcopy RecursionError with an uncachable original-parser fallback, preserving fresh mutable returns and every original byte/ref/check boundary.
Independently review the exact successor including first miss and hit fallback, exception equivalence, cleanup, uncached final reads and untouched original namespace lifecycle.

Only after a component source pass, separately bind and review a never-launched actual future consumer with complete current-control closure, exact guard/source/runtime/history refs and ROOT admission. No current or older job may adopt this component from this review.
